scientific_integrity: All enumeration programs and finite certificates are included. Computational results were checked with independently implemented Sardinas--Patterson procedures. No external audit or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: This is an exact finite classification for unordered binary word sets with both lengths three and four and Kraft sum one. It is not an all-length theorem; the count is conditional on exact enumeration. Earlier unindexed tables cannot be ruled out.
title: Complete classification of binary Kraft-equality codes of lengths three and four
